title: Faith that refuses to bow.
paragraphs:
A king built a statue.
An empire demanded worship.
A furnace waited for anyone who refused.

Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego did not negotiate with fear.
They did not bow to power.
They did not trade faith for safety.
"Our God is able to deliver us… but even if He does not, we will not serve your gods." — Daniel 3:17–18

The fire was real.
The threat was real.
But when the flames rose, heaven stepped in.

The king expected ashes.
Instead he saw four men walking in the fire.

Faith does not always remove the furnace.
Sometimes it reveals Who walks with you in it.

🔥 The question is not whether pressure will come.
The question is what you will bow to when it does.
What would it take for you to refuse to bow?
